headSubject: chore(session): handoff -- WMS-13/14 fixed + REG-249, WMS-15/16 filed for Wave 8
summary: Closed WMS-15 (Expedicao's Confirmar Saida had no confirmation step) by wiring the DSL's existing but previously-dead flow.action.confirmationText field into real behavior end-to-end (PanelRuntime.panelActions resolves it server-side, business-ui-app.mustache gates the button click with window.confirm), instead of hand-authoring a bypass page -- a platform-wide fix, not a one-off. Also hit and documented a serious session-infrastructure failure: a run_in_background task's completion notification silently never fired for 6h22m; recorded as a durable ALERT at the top of CLAUDE.md and a matching feedback memory, plus the discovered fact that Rebuild-And-Restage.ps1 -SkipProvenanceCheck skips its entire step 4 (build+start+gate), not just the gate.
nextStep: Pick up WMS-16 next (ledger/items/WMS-16.yml, MEDIUM, largest-scoped Wave 8 residual): item-level wizard sub-panels (Adicionar Itens selection, row clone, duplicate-product refusal, computed Total) are not declared on RecebimentoWorkbench or ExpedicaoWorkbench at all. Start with Recebimento only per the item's own suggested scoping; check whether MovimentoLivrePanel's existing rowOps/addFormFields pattern already covers the Adicionar Itens half before assuming new generator work is needed. Before that: the four changed files (CLAUDE.md, business-ui-app.mustache, PanelRuntime.java, ledger/items/WMS-15.yml) plus AppGen/apps/_official/WmsOffice/definition/model.json (outside this repo) are still uncommitted -- commit WMS-15's fix first if the user wants it kept. QUAL-41 (MEDIUM) is also still open.
verified: Full Build-FinalApp.ps1 against the assembled wmsoffice-browser app: compileJava, the FULL :test task (including pre-existing PanelRuntimeFlowActionTest/PanelRuntimeRowScopedActionTest), :check, :build all green, no regressions. Live REST check against the booted app (bootstrapped a throwaway admin, logged in for a JWT): GET /api/runtime/metadata/ui/panels/ExpedicaoDemandaPanel's actions[] now carries confirmationText verbatim as declared. NOT verified: an actual browser click through window.confirm() (ScrapForAI) -- noted honestly in the ledger closure as a residual gap.
